notes:
Persona pool, sub-view "Personas" of the Use Cases tab. Data: dimensions + personas from `list_use_cases`; tools `set_use_cases` (personas, dimensions) and `generate_personas`. Full length 1440×1260.

**Left panel:** search ("Search personas, goals, traits…"), "11 personas · 4 dimensions", list split into "Written by people · 5" and "Generated from dimensions · 6" (generated names ellipsize); selected = active fill, the main area scrolls to its card. `+` = new persona.

**Main (56px side padding):**
- Header "User pool" + one-paragraph explanation (a missing trait = any value). Actions: **Generate from dimensions** (secondary → `usecases-generate-dialog`) and **New persona** (primary → `usecases-edit-dialog-persona`).
- Dimensions table: label + id (click → `usecases-dimension-dialog`), values as `uc-value-chip` with the count of personas holding the value; a value no persona has uses `uc-value-chip gap` + "No persona has this value". A note when personas leave a dimension open ("6 personas leave it open (any value)"). "+ Dimension" → `usecases-dimension-dialog` (new).
- Persona cards (`uc-persona-card`), 3 columns: avatar, name, role · id, trait chips, goals, usage ("In 5 use cases"). `generated`: dashed border, sidebar fill, "Generated" marker, open dimension as dashed "Role any" chip, empty goals prompt.
- Last grid cell: dashed "New persona" tile.
